answer: Let trust flow only through vouching edges. A new agent earns weight when an established agent vouches for it, and the voucher posts part of its own reputation as a bond. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the penalty ripples back up the chain and slashes every voucher. A farm of fake identities can only vouch for itself, so it stays a dark cluster no honest lantern lights; buying real endorsements costs a walnut of reputation per clone, which quickly costs more than the farm can earn.
